conditional_findings.severity: unassigned; conditional observed held entity without properties
conditional_findings.classification: Prior 059 finding re-assessed against byte-identical 95e preview and current producer/receiver source; no additional historical finding or proven unique issue.
conditional_findings.trace: The active grab finds a held Entity through ItemOf and EquipSlot, then derives HeldPreviewItem from held.and_then(properties.get(...).ok()). If the entity exists but ItemProperties is absent, From<Option<&ItemProperties>> classifies it as Empty. The shared eligibility helper permits Empty to address the outermost occupied target while Unknown permits none. The current HUD path also queries held items through a tuple that requires ItemProperties and EquipmentTopology.
conditional_findings.safeguards: The server projection normally inserts ItemOf and ItemProperties together for a newly projected item; the replication configuration registers these components separately. Server actions retain expected hand item and revision checks. Those source facts do not by themselves establish whether a successful client update can ever observe a held entity without its properties.
conditional_findings.first_failed_contract: An observed held entity lacking its properties or admitted catalogue definition must remain distinct from a genuinely empty hand at preview admission.
conditional_findings.canonical_owner: Held-item presence witness and catalogue/property admission at the existing grab preview boundary.
conditional_findings.connected_repair: After full audit and separate implementation authorization, preserve entity presence through the preview decision; retain empty-hand, unknown-item and valid placement behavior and server authority checks.
conditional_findings.later_acceptance: Only after separate product-validation authorization, cover permitted replication/component lifetimes, empty hands, known and unknown held items, keyboard and page selection, and server rejection/acceptance.
conditional_findings.discovery: partial; actual replicated component timing, HUD/item lifecycle and exact aliases remain open

conditional_findings.severity: unassigned; conditional preparation or fit failure
conditional_findings.classification: Prior 059 finding re-assessed at bounded 95e source and strategic readiness consumer; no additional historical finding or proven unique issue.
conditional_findings.trace: Runtime body or design preparation logs an owned error and retains cache.failed as a boolean. Async fit and equipment-part preparation format errors into String in the retained model cache; support fitting reconstructs an anyhow error from the text. A failed result sets unit ProceduralEquipmentFailed/Resolved markers, and EquipmentReadiness returns a generic static error, which strategic status converts to its reported error.
conditional_findings.limits: These are source-level error paths; no asset, GPU, task or fit failure was induced. The fit cache, per-item admission and global body failure are different operations and must retain their own stage/context in any exact alias decision.
conditional_findings.first_failed_contract: A requested equipment preparation outcome must retain loading, success and owned cause/context through cache and readiness instead of replacing an error with an unrelated success/absence or generic marker.
conditional_findings.canonical_owner: Prepared body/design and per-fit outcome, connected through equipment readiness to the strategic status boundary.
conditional_findings.connected_repair: After audit, carry structured causes and item/body/placement context through the shared cache and readiness; preserve pending, successful, held, dropped and refit modes without assuming all error families are aliases.
conditional_findings.later_acceptance: Only after separate validation authorization, cover each actual body, design, support, fit and installation failure, successful and pending paths, and current strategic status consumers.
conditional_findings.discovery: partial; actual asset/task errors, type ownership, all consumers and exact global aliases remain open

conditional_findings.classification: New current-source conditional appearance admission and readiness candidate; earlier equipment error and historical scene questions remain separately qualified.
conditional_findings.trace: BrowserCommand deserializes StrategicView containing Vec<EquipmentAppearance>; each item and placement is an unrestricted String. The scene equipment synchronizer creates an entity for each appearance but despawns it if item_catalog::definition is None or its equipment field is None, without inserting SceneEquipment or recording a failure. It stores the original appearance list in Wardrobe, so an identical later view is skipped. Strategic status passes only existing SceneEquipment entities to EquipmentReadiness; for an otherwise ready scene with one such omitted request and no other items, the empty iterator yields Ok(true), allowing complete readiness when all unrelated gates are satisfied.
conditional_findings.producer_safeguards: The normal HTTP route draws each appearance from a character_equipped_item row and finds the matching inventory item; the equipped table has inventory_item_id as a primary key. The JavaScript producer waits for a response for every requested character. These facts constrain normal identity production, but the inspected route does not resolve item.item_id against the client catalogue before emitting it. No claim is made that a valid normal database supplies an unknown or non-equipment item.
conditional_findings.limits: The described case is a source-level conditional admitted payload, not an observed production response, browser scene, renderer state or failure. Other scene, asset and pipeline readiness gates remain required. A selected policy may explicitly reject or deliberately report degraded omission; silently treating a requested unadmitted appearance as fully ready is the unresolved contract. This differs from an admitted fit that emits ProceduralEquipmentFailed.
conditional_findings.first_failed_contract: Requested appearance rows need an explicit admitted, failed or intentionally omitted outcome that readiness can account for; unrecognized requests must not vanish from the readiness population without a policy verdict.
conditional_findings.canonical_owner: Strategic appearance admission and per-request presentation outcome feeding the existing scene readiness/status owner.
conditional_findings.connected_repair: After full audit and separate implementation authorization, validate appearance identity and catalogue/equipment admission at the appropriate boundary, retain an owned per-row failure or explicit degradation, and make readiness reflect every requested appearance. Preserve normal empty wardrobes and valid runtime fitting; do not introduce legacy fallbacks.
conditional_findings.later_acceptance: Only after separate validation authorization, cover absent and non-equipment catalogue items, valid empty wardrobes, valid items, unchanged views, repair/retry policy and complete scene readiness.
conditional_findings.discovery: partial; actual producer admission, intentional degradation policy, all appearance consumers and exact aliases remain open

observations.trace: Client preview and authoritative server both sort body roots by EquipmentTopology::root_order and recursively traverse ordered attachment point and capacity slots. The server excludes scene roots and retains full attachment identity, then checks expected destination and revision; the client preview uses a compact addressed entity plus depth.
observations.remaining: Equality of ordering assumes compatible admitted topology and client/server snapshots; duplicate roots, ownership/scene transition, key ties and concurrent mutations need actual invariant and replication traces. No synthetic invalid graph or unrun fixture establishes a defect.

observations.trace: Procedural parts start hidden, use the joint-bound mesh only after skin exists, and derive a joint-free centered mesh for unbound states. EquipmentReadiness counts visible resolved roots and requires relevant parts not hidden; strategic status combines that with scene, texture, pipeline and settling gates.
observations.remaining: Root count is not a per-item uniqueness check. A duplicate ready root plus a missing root could numerically mask the missing item, but no valid duplicate-root producer was established; retain as an open invariant question, not a separate finding. No rendering or readiness run.

existing_contract_connections.qualification: The earlier held-preview finding retains its own revision and identity; current component timing and all preview invariants are unresolved.
An omitted unadmitted appearance and a failed admitted fit have distinct first outcomes; a common readiness remedy does not prove an alias. Earlier source questions retain their scope.
